	local name="$2"

	[ -n "$name" ] && printf ' %s' "$name" >> "$KEEPALIVED_CONF"
	printf ' {\n' >> "$KEEPALIVED_CONF"

command:
wc -l /tmp/vip_ping.log
grep -n 'seq' /tmp/vip_ping.log | awk -F'[][]' '{print $2, $0}' | awk '{print $1}' > /tmp/times.txt
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
lines = open('/tmp/vip_ping.log').read().splitlines()
prev=None
gaps=[]
seqs=[]
for l in lines:
    m = re.match(r'\[(\d+\.\d+)\].*icmp_seq=(\d+)', l)
    if m:
        t=float(m.group(1)); s=int(m.group(2))
        seqs.append(s)
        if prev is not None and t-prev>1.0:
            gaps.append((prev,t,t-prev))
        prev=t
print("total replies:", len(seqs))
print("seq range:", min(seqs), max(seqs))
print("missing seqs:", sorted(set(range(min(seqs),max(seqs)+1))-set(seqs)))
print("gaps >1s:", gaps)
EOF
